question: Which of the following is currently the only contraindication for conservative surgical treatment in breast cancer?
analysis: Conservative surgical treatment, such as lumpectomy, is generally contraindicated in cases of multifocal tumors because the presence of multiple tumor foci in different quadrants of the breast makes it difficult to achieve clear margins while preserving breast tissue. Other options like prior radiotherapy, tumor size, axillary metastasis, and pregnancy are not absolute contraindications, as they can be managed with careful planning and adjunctive therapies.
